decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Design and Access Statement;  0X4083-P-004B,0X4083-P-005A 0X4082-P-006-A, 0X4083-P-218 Received 30/9/09, 0X4083-P-215H & 0X4083-P-217 G received 25/10/10,
Ecological Study received 11/5/10) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted bridge have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until the applicant, their agent or successors in title has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological work, in accordance with a written scheme of investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until full details of the proposed gates (including the means by which they are to be locked) to be installed as part of the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No development shall; take place until full details of all external lighting to be installed as part of the development have been submitted to and approved sin writing by the local Planning Authority
Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the ecological mitigation methods identified in paragraph 4.8 of the Ash Partnership Mollusc Survey Report dated April 2010.
Condition : 8 - The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in strict accordance with the plans.OX-4083-P-215.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until details of the proposed signage at the entrance and exit of the site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Construction of a riverside walkway and bridge linking the riverside footpath at Heron's Place to the Nazareth House site
